title: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we introduce Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts each weight update to the bottom singular subspace, eliminating changes along the principal directions. SST is optimizer-agnostic and composes well with fine-tuning recipes including SFT and self-distillation. translated_title: 迈向持续学习：通过子空间微调缓解遗忘
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.22293v1 通告类型：交叉 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）通过微调获得新技能，但这可能会破坏其已有能力：灾难性遗忘仍然是LLM持续学习的核心障碍。近期研究将遗忘与微调移动权重的幅度及方向联系起来。强化学习和在线策略蒸馏等在线策略方法由于避免更新权重矩阵的主奇异方向，因此遗忘较少。相比之下，SFT将更新集中在这些方向上，容易发生灾难性遗忘。在本工作中，我们提出子空间微调，它将每次权重更新限制在底部奇异子空间内，消除沿主方向的变化。SST与优化器无关，并且能够与包括SFT和自蒸馏在内的各种微调方法良好结合。SST结合了紧凑的子空间保护、密集的梯度估计以及一个简单的刷新机制（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出子空间微调（SST）方法，将权重更新限制在底部奇异子空间、避免改变主奇异方向，从而有效缓解大语言模型微调中的灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts weight updates to the bottom singular subspace to avoid altering principal singular directions, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting in LLM fine-tuning.
